title: Add A2A repair visibility planning
summary: A2A repair is operator-owned today. If delegated repair expands, operators need per-peer visibility and tests that prove retries and repairs cannot hide peer-specific failures.
expectedFailureModes: Delegated repair can mutate peer queues without operator-visible peer attribution.
Retry visibility aggregates failures in a way that hides one failing peer.
Tests only cover operator repair and miss delegated denial paths.
nextAction: Add a bounded per-peer repair visibility plan or read-only report, with tests around peer filters and delegated-repair denial paths.
